caption: Hot caramel is poured onto a cold marble slab, and the caramel spreads, then stiffens into a glassy sheet.

sa.check: Hot caramel is poured onto the slab.
The caramel spreads across the slab.
The caramel stiffens into a sheet.
The order is pour, spread, stiffen.

pc.expect: The caramel spreads while it is hot, then slows and stops and stays where it has set.
pc.fail: A set part of the sheet flows again with nothing heating it; or the sheet draws back toward the point where it was poured; or the caramel spreads, stops and spreads again with none added; or the sheet alternates between runny and set.

pc.expect: The caramel arrives as a thick liquid that flows and levels and sets as a rigid brittle sheet that cracks rather than bends.
pc.fail: The set sheet bends or sags when lifted; or stretches like toffee when pulled; or the caramel runs as thin as water over the slab; or the sheet crumbles to powder as it sets.

pc.expect: The caramel runs downhill across the slab and over its edge where the slab slopes, and the pour falls downward from the pan.
pc.fail: The caramel climbs the slab's raised edge and stays; or flows uphill across the slab; or the stream travels upward from the pan; or the sheet lifts off the slab and hangs.

pc.expect: The slab shows the caramel arriving: the sheet is thickest where the pour landed and thins outward, and it fills the slab's hollows.
pc.fail: The sheet is thickest far from where the pour landed with nothing moving it there; or caramel appears on a part of the slab the flow never reached; or the sheet bridges over a hollow in the slab without touching it.

pc.expect: One pour and one sheet; the caramel goes from the pan onto the slab and nowhere else.
pc.fail: Caramel appears on the slab with none pouring there; or the sheet vanishes; or the caramel passes through the slab; or a second sheet appears.

pc.expect: The slab's veining away from the caramel and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The slab's veining changes pattern; or the pan changes shape; or items around the slab rearrange.

note: The caramel's colour is the product of cooking done before the clip; further darkening is chemistry and is not judged.
